appearanceLevelChecksThisLaneRan: Delivered canonical and boundary page text diffed against the pinned source page text. The canonical adds exactly three lines — the name, the date of birth, and the address/city/state/ZIP line — and the boundary exactly three. Nothing else was added anywhere on the eight pages: no build commentary, no internal vocabulary, no packet identifier, no route key.

Pages 1, 2, 4, 5 and 7 of both fixtures read as images. All five repeating tables empty; the victim Name column does not carry the applicant name; the three phone boxes, the SSN, race and place-of-birth boxes empty; signature and date empty; page 8 statute text unchanged.

The Pardon tick measured in the output bytes as a flattened appearance content stream of 34 bytes against 0 for the same widget in the pinned source; the other three relief boxes 0 in both. Confirmed visually as a filled box beside Pardon and three empty boxes.

The tick detector was mutation-tested: forcing a mark onto a box the field map refuses raised protectedWrites to 2 and returned STOPPED with exit 2. The mutation was run in a throwaway copy writing to a throwaway directory, both deleted; the delivered packet was rebuilt from clean afterwards and is byte-identical across three independent runs.
Row indices of all five repeating tables checked against page geometry, and column order against the x-order of each table printed heading. Recorded in reports/caption-evidence.json orderingChecks.
Every AcroForm field name traced to this form. No caption, label or field name in this packet derives from another jurisdiction; the packet contains zero mentions of any other state.
